_comment: Template for h2h_config.json (base vs v5 head-to-head, ./ctl_h2h.sh): copy it to <RLTLDR_ROOT>/h2h_config.json (gitignored) or point H2H_CONFIG at a copy, and fill in each arm's GPU (gpu_uuid from `nvidia-smi -L`, gpu_minor = N of /dev/nvidiaN; the runner refuses an arm without them). Relative paths are resolved against RLTLDR_ROOT, ~ is expanded. baseline_commit is the canon.git commit both arms start from (h2h/start is built on it: tools/h2h/setup.py --create-start). Keys starting with _ are ignored.
